methodology.scope: recursive src Python plus three root entry/config files; all static JS/CSS/HTML
methodology.complexity: AST decision-count proxy excluding nested scopes and with statements; not formal McCabe
methodology.unused: untyped name/string reference heuristic in production only; zero mentions is a candidate, never proof of unused code
methodology.limits: No runtime timing/optimality claim; dynamic callbacks, reflection, public APIs and inheritance require manual inspection.
